subject.title: Workspaces: add Living Answers and action forms

question: Should bundled Workspaces allow workspace-authored action forms to submit operator-confirmed prompts into the active agent session through `chat.send`?
rationale: Code review can verify the limits, but automation cannot decide whether this new first-party authority belongs in the product or who permanently owns its security contract.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded action form
options.body: Accept the confirmed prompt-only boundary after error feedback, direct behavior proof, and exact-head checks are complete.

options.title: Split Living Answers
options.body: Land expiry and pinning separately while deferring action forms until their authority contract receives dedicated approval.

options.title: Keep Workspaces presentation-only
options.body: Decline bundled workspace-authored prompt submission and remove the action-form portion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded action form
recommendation.body: Accept the confirmed prompt-only boundary after error feedback, direct behavior proof, and exact-head checks are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline contains the clearest explicit product and security review signal for this feature.
